self.text: I’m Dell, early 20s, non‑binary, from Poland. I love running trails when I’m not in front of the screen. On my console I mainly play Skyforge Arena, usually joining casual matches. I work as a support, keeping the team alive and moving. I chat with teammates over voice so we can coordinate in real time. I’m free on Saturday mornings, Sunday mornings, and Sunday afternoons, so let’s pick a time that works for both of us. I enjoy the relaxed vibe of casual games and the teamwork that comes with supporting others. Outside of gaming I like exploring new paths on foot, feeling the wind and the rhythm of my strides. If you’re into supportive teamwork and good conversation, we might click. I’m looking forward to sharing a friendly gaming session and maybe a trail run or two. Let’s chat and find a time that fits our schedules.
